text: At 65 minutes, Seabrook Town changes tactics and begins pressing higher up the field on the left side while playing more direct toward Harbour City's goal at the far end. Their defensive line moves forward, increasing pressure and aiming to regain possession quickly. Harbour City holds firm in central positions as Seabrook Town attempts to create chances with this new approach[#1361].
